beats: There you are. Maren said someone would come asking after the seals.
Ah. You have the look of someone who has been underground. Maren's message, I take it?

text: Tell me it is done, and I will carry the word back myself.
Is it finished? Say the word and I'll be on the road.

choices.text: The seals are broken. Take the word to Maren.

thanks.text: Then the old wards hold no longer, and the hills are safer for it.

thanks: Go. I will be on the road before you reach the door.
